plugins.name: ai-zettelkasten
plugins.description: Automatic knowledge extraction from Claude sessions using Stop hooks. Captures facts, decisions, patterns to Obsidian and S3 Vectors.

plugins.name: cc-plugin-authoring
plugins.description: Hard-won gotchas from authoring Claude Code plugins and APM marketplaces. Bundles two reference skills: APM marketplace authoring gotchas (apm pack vs compile, pluginRoot rewrites, prettier conflicts) and the YAML parse trap on slash-command argument-hint values.

plugins.name: claudeception
plugins.description: Extracts reusable skills from Claude Code sessions at session end. Analyzes for non-obvious discoveries and creates SKILL.md files.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development workflow tools — README generation, code review, and more.

plugins.name: isengardcli-aws-auth
plugins.description: Enforces AWS authentication via isengardcli. Blocks direct aws/cdk/deploy commands. Uses environment variables (DEV, GAMMA, PROD) with color-coded warnings.

plugins.name: iterm-job-controller
plugins.description: iTerm2 terminal job dispatcher and session controller — manages terminal sessions, dispatches jobs, and monitors their progress.

plugins.name: iterm-utils
plugins.description: iTerm2 utilities for Claude Code — pane and session management.

plugins.name: md-to-pdf
plugins.description: Convert markdown directories to PDF with Mermaid diagram rendering.

plugins.name: obsidian-memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory system using Obsidian vault. Teaches Claude when/how to use Obsidian for storing decisions, learnings, workflow facts, and retrieving context.

plugins.name: pr-monitor
plugins.description: Automated PR monitoring with Stop hook that auto-resumes Claude Code when new commits are detected.

plugins.name: semantic-search
plugins.description: Semantic search over Obsidian Zettelkasten notes using LanceDB and sentence-transformers for local embeddings.

plugins.name: session-mining
plugins.description: Mine Claude Code sessions for knowledge extraction. Process session history to identify learnings, patterns, and improvement opportunities.

plugins.name: zettelkasten
plugins.description: AI-powered Zettelkasten knowledge management with local ChromaDB vector search. Supports notes, tasks, bookmarks with Luhmann-style IDs and automatic connection discovery.
